def task_func(url):
    system = platform.system()
    if system == 'Windows':
        cmd = ['start', url]
        process = subprocess.Popen(cmd, shell=True)
    elif system == 'Darwin':
        cmd = ['open', url]
        process = subprocess.Popen(cmd)
    else:
        cmd = ['xdg-open', url]
        process = subprocess.Popen(cmd)

    time.sleep(0.1)

    ret_code = process.poll()
    if ret_code is None:
        return 0
    return ret_code
